reason: I buy my parts in the market where I can hold the battery and argue the price, and my electrician wires it for me. An app sending me offers from companies I don't know doesn't tell me whether the panel is real or fake, so I'd rather walk the shops myself.
objection: Half the batteries and panels in the market are fake or weaker than the label says. A written offer with a brand name on paper proves nothing, and the companies could just pay for good spots in the app.
would_change_my_mind: If a shop owner I know in my area told me they got a system through it and it held up through the power cuts, or if the companies had to stand behind the warranty with SunXFinder holding them to it.
